method: Read complete code-behind and full XAML in consecutive nontruncated chunks after initial truncated combined output; pinned Git blobs verified.
findings: Loaded starts fire-and-forget supporter fetch. Loaded flag is set only after nonempty response; empty/failure causes later reload retries, and concurrent Loaded events can overlap before completion. No in-flight guard, cancellation or Unloaded check.

Fetch completion explicitly captures context ConfigureAwait(true), then updates ItemsSource; exceptions are swallowed. Empty list and fetch failure have no separate visible error state in these files.
Supporter profile URL from model Tag goes to ProcessStartInfo with UseShellExecute=true without scheme allowlist here. Review performed no URL launch.

XAML contains remote developer avatar and supporter images through earlier-reviewed converter, plus repeated unbounded-duration visual animations. No reduced-motion selection or explicit animation teardown appears here.

SupporterItemStyle uses TranslateTransform but its MouseEnter/Leave storyboards target ScaleTransform.ScaleX/Y on the same Border. Incompatible target path is a static concern requiring WPF reproduction. Avatar style uses ScaleTransform and is compatible with these hover paths.
Version display reads executing assembly major/minor/build, discarding revision and any prerelease label. This is distinct from release filename version discussed earlier.
Supporter ItemsControl uses WrapPanel without explicit virtualization; viewport MaxHeight300 bounds view, not materialized item count.
limits: Source review only; no remote avatar fetching, browser launch, Windows rendering or original runtime tests. No production implementation adopted.
